purpose: Human-only primary visible anomaly boxes for the selected material-2 qualitative recall set. They are not electrical diagnoses, training labels, threshold-calibration ground truth, or production metrics.

coordinate_space.inspection_rendering: Each raw 1254x1254 inspection image is resized to 575x517 only for side-by-side manual drawing; no registration, candidate box, heatmap, or score is shown.

annotation_protocol.unit: one visually conspicuous primary loose/disconnected conductor group per image; other broad generated differences are deliberately not counted.
annotation_protocol.selection: The selected image list comes from cabinet_material2_qualitative_selection_20260827.json.
annotation_protocol.metric_policy: qualitative candidate-coverage review only; no pooled threshold, hit rate, or false-positive rate.

groups.description: Upper-middle white conductor descends from the terminal area and ends with an exposed copper tip near the upper rail.
Central-to-lower white conductor is visibly separated from normal routing and has a free exposed end.
White upper-middle conductor hangs down across the rail with a red-tipped free end.
Upper-middle long white free conductor is visibly separated from the regular terminal bundles.
A second long white conductor hangs freely through the lower-middle cabinet area.

limits: The source images are AI-generated variants and may contain unrelated global changes.
The boxes are manually drawn before candidate replay, but this is still not a double-blind annotation study.
Coverage is an operator-review aid, not a production correctness claim.
